answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded re-attestation. Each identity stakes a bond priced at one honest agent's inference cost, binding slashable capital. The bond unlocks only after probation audits, where a verifier-chosen random subset must submit signed traces within a window. A thousand personas means a thousand funded bonds; one missed draw slashes the bond. Draws come from a public tide of epoch entropy, so nobody predicts who is sampled. Bond size is retuned each epoch so forgery costs more than a vote pays; the fable of free crowds dies there, unbacked identities drifting off like timber.
